title: Going deeper: Choose one purpose
categoryContext: Growing independence at home, school and online
stageSummary: Notice adult pressure, observable cues and the sentence that is about to leave the mouth.
pressureLine: Just do everything I told you.
possibleWeather: Older children may hear pressure as mistrust, public judgement or loss of agency. Make the reason, choice and responsibility visible.
boundary: A clear expectation is still needed.
practice: choose the most important action for this moment
principle: Reduce competing goals to one safe, teachable priority.
nextSentence: A clear expectation is still needed. Tell me what is getting in the way, then we can choose the most important action for this moment.
keyLearning: Reduce competing goals to one safe, teachable priority.
